core_meaning.primary_meaning: Jaffer is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Stream or River”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Jaffer corresponds to the Arabic form جعفر (Arabic جَعْفَر (Jaʿfar)). Its core sense is ja'far; a male given name. Jaffer is a South Asian transliteration of Arabic جَعْفَر (Jaʿfar), a well-documented male given name. The source gloss 'Stream or River' is unsupported; the name is a proper name. Same name as jafar, jaffar and jaafar.
